unresolved.question: Page legend lists ক কলকলাহ, শ শিষ, গ গুন্নাহ, ম মোটা, ২ ইখফা, ringed ∧ আরবী সাকিন (no digit legend); labels follow the existing convention (শীষ, মোটা (পুর), ইখফা) and the default digit labels for ১/৩/৪/৬.
Row 0: verse circle ২১ carries a small ط with the word السجدة (sajdah mark); the ط is encoded as ؕ on يَسْجُدُوْنَ, the sajdah label itself is not encoded.
Rows 1: waqf signs over verse circles ২২ and ২৩ are printed as صلے; encoded as ۖ.
Rows 1, 3, 4, 6: waqf over circles ২৪, ১, ২, ৪, ৫, ৮ is a small لا; encoded as ۙ. Circles ৩, ৭, ৯, ১০ and the mid-ayah sign after وَالْاَرْضِ carry a small ط; encoded as ؕ.
Row 6: the ringed-wedge over الْحَمِيْدِ is printed with ৬ but without ক.
Where ১ and ম (or ১শম) are printed together over one letter (وَاللّٰهُ rows 1 and 7, الصّٰلِحٰتِ rows 2 and 9), all are anchored to that one letter (the shadda lam / shadda sad).
Row 6: madd sign over the final alif of اِلَّآ is a small tilde; encoded as maddah U+0653; band digit read as ৩.

Ruku sign ع beside circle ২৫, the ruku box in the margin, the sajdah box on the left of row 0, the QR codes beside rows 3 and 9 and the পারা-৩০ / '৮৫ সূরা বুরূজ' margin labels are not encoded; the header box prints no Arabic surah name.
